# █ Mini Gradient Array 16S Pipeline

This document and the code within depends on QIIME2 (.qza) files which need to be generated in a QIIME2 miniconda environment outside of R before R processing can occur. The below code merges sets of premade .qza files.

```         
conda update conda
conda activate qiime2-amplicon-2024.10
cd qiime2-MGA
qiime feature-table merge  --i-tables *table.qza --o-merged-table MergeTable.qza  --p-overlap-method sum
qiime feature-table merge-seqs --i-data *sequences.qza --o-merged-data MergeSeqs.qza
qiime feature-table merge-taxa --i-data *q2taxonomy.qza --o-merged-data MergeTaxa.qza
?????????????????
qiime feature-table merge-taxa --i-data *denovotree.qza --o-merged-data MergeTree.qza
```

## Define Functions

Defines the following reusable functions:

`%notin%`, which creates the opposite of `%in%`

`getDist`, which subsets and obtains a distance matrix from an ASV table given an already-subset metadata file.

`doPCA`, which performs a PCA given an asv_table and subset metadata.

`graphPCA`, which graphs a PCA with ggplot, given the results of a `doPCA`. Group, Color, and Shape should be variables representing columns in the metadata. Title is a string (in quotes) containing the desired graph title. Datatype needs to be set to "manual" or "continuous" depending on what kind of variable you are hoping to plot.

```{r}

#Create 'notin' operator
`%notin%` <- function(x,y) !(x %in% y)

getDist <- function(asv_table,metaSet){
  
  #subset asv table according to how you subset meta earlier
  asvSet <- as.data.frame(subset(asv_table, row.names(asv_table) %in% row.names(metaSet)))
  
  #Distance Matrix
  dist<- asvSet + 0.5 # THIS IS THE PSEUDOCOUNT THAT MAKE_CLR USES
  perm_dist<-vegdist(dist, method='aitchison')
  
  return(perm_dist)
}

doPCA<-function(asv_table,metaSet,level){
  
  asvSet <- as.data.frame(subset(asv_table, row.names(asv_table) %in% row.names(metaSet)))
  pc<- asvSet %>% t() %>% make_clr() %>%t() %>% prcomp() #Use only with unrarified data (makes log-center transform)

  pca<- as.data.frame(pc$x) %>% rownames_to_column("NewName") 
  names<-as.data.frame(pca$NewName)
  exp<-(pc$sdev^2)/sum(pc$sdev^2)*100
  exp<-round(exp, 2)
  scores <- data.frame(pc$x[, 1:5]) #this gives me the right scores for the PCA
  colnames(scores) <- colnames(data.frame(pc$x[, 1:5]))
  scores[] <- lapply(scores, function(x) x / sqrt(sum((x - mean(x))^2))) #makes them small
  loadings <- as.data.frame(pc$rotation)[1:5]
  scale <- min(max(abs(scores$PC1))/max(abs(loadings$PC1)),
               max(abs(scores$PC2))/max(abs(loadings$PC2))) * 0.8
  
#Calculate the length of each loading
  loadinglength<-loadings
  loadinglength$dist <- sqrt(loadings$PC1^2 + loadings$PC2^2)
  rownames(loadinglength) <- rownames(loadings)
  loadinglength$Feature.ID <- rownames(loadings)
  
#Order from biggest to smallest
  loadinglength$rank <- rank(-loadinglength$dist) #Rank from largest to smallest...
  loadinglength<- loadinglength[order(loadinglength$rank), ] #Now order them that way
  loadinglength <-  loadinglength[1:10, ]    # SUBSAMPLE however many top hits you wanna look at!
  
#Now we have to ID who is who
  loadinglength_taxa <- left_join(loadinglength, taxa, by = "Feature.ID")
  loadinglength_taxa_loadings<- loadinglength_taxa[, c(1, 2)]
  loadinglength_taxa<-parse_taxonomy(loadinglength_taxa) #Parse the taxonomy so the table isnt 1 billion years long
  
#Return a list object that contains a bunch of useful graphing information
  return(list(names=names, scores=scores,exp=exp,loadings=loadinglength_taxa_loadings,taxa=loadinglength_taxa,scale=scale))
  
}

```


# █ Import, filter, and classify ASVs

## DADA2 Feature Classification

Generates ASV_d2taxonomy.txt text file; checks to see if this file has already been generated, and doesn't re-run if the file is found. This file matches all ASVs to taxonomic units. Code originally taken from Jordan Bisanz 16S pipeline.

```{r, echo=FALSE}
# generates taxonomy which is used later in the bar chart...

# READ ASV SEQUENCES IN
ASV_seq<-read_qza("qiime merge/MergeSeqs.qza")$data

if(!file.exists("qiime merge/ASV_d2taxonomy.txt")){
  message(date(), " Assigning taxonomy with dada2")
  
  #seqs<-read_qza("qiime merge/MergeSeqs.qza")$data
  taxonomy <- assignTaxonomy(as.character(ASV_seq), "silva_nr99_v138.1_wSpecies_train_set.fa.gz", multithread=as.integer(8))
  taxonomy <- addSpecies(taxonomy, "silva_species_assignment_v138.1.fa.gz", allowMultiple=TRUE)
  colnames(taxonomy)[8]<-"Species_ambiguous"
 
  as.data.frame(taxonomy) %>%
    rownames_to_column("Sequence") %>%
    left_join(tibble(ASV=names(ASV_seq), Sequence=as.character(ASV_seq))) %>%
    dplyr::select(ASV, Kingdom, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, Species, Species_ambiguous, Sequence) %>%
    write_tsv("qiime merge/ASV_d2taxonomy.txt")
  
} else {
  message(date(), " Skipping Dada2 taxonomy as already complete")
}

taxonomy<-read_tsv("qiime merge/ASV_d2taxonomy.txt")

```

## Filter ASV Table

The ASV table contains all samples in the dataset (columns) and corresponding frequency/amount of ASVs (rows). This dataset is full of 0's and needs to be significantly trimmed. Here we read in the data (ASV table and taxonomy) and trim the table.

```{r message=FALSE}


# Read taxonomy (from qiime) and metadata in
taxa<-read_qza("qiime merge/MergeTaxa.qza")
taxa <- taxa[["data"]]
metadata<-read_excel("Macalady_Metadata_Sumtable.xlsx")  

asv_table<-read_qza("qiime merge/MergeTable.qza")$data # Create main asv_table object
asv_untrim <- asv_table # Save untrimmed version of the ASV table in case we need it later

# Filter Sequencing controls
asv_table<-asv_table[,!grepl("ZymoCom|ZymoDNA|NTC|ExtCon", colnames(asv_table))] %>% filter_features(1,1)

#filtering samples ***MAJOR filter STEP***
# present in 2 samples, at least 5 reads
asv_table<-asv_table[,colSums(asv_table)>5] %>% filter_features(2,5)
#asv_table<-asv_table[,colSums(asv_table)>5] %>% filter_features(20,500)

# At this step, grab total reads from the ASV table for later
reads<-as.data.frame(colSums(asv_table)) #Grab number of total reads per sample
colnames(reads) <-"reads" #Rename 

### Export CSV for Viewing
#Assign taxonomy to the ASV table; export a trimmed version of this with appropriate sample names as an .csv. This will be useful to look at later in excel.

asv_table<-as.data.frame(asv_table)
asv_table_taxa<-asv_table
featureID<-as.data.frame(rownames(asv_table_taxa))
asv_table_taxa$FeatureID <- taxa$Taxon[match(rownames(asv_table_taxa), taxa$Feature.ID)]
write.csv(asv_table_taxa, "asv_table_taxa.csv")

rm(asv_table_taxa,featureID)
```

## Calculate Diversity Metrics

In order to calculate diversity metrics for the ASV table, we first have to take a transposed replicate of asv_table to work with so things come out by sample and not by OTU. Then we can calculate a new metadata file that contains alpha diversity metrics and then join that to the original metadata file.

```{r}

asv_table<-as.data.frame(t(asv_table))

reads <- reads[match(rownames(asv_table),rownames(reads)),,drop=FALSE]

# Calculate Diversity Metrics
meta_alpha <- cbind(as.data.frame(vegan::diversity(asv_table, index = "shannon", equalize.groups = FALSE, MARGIN = 1, base = exp(1))) , 
              as.data.frame(simpson.unb(asv_table, inverse = FALSE)), 
              as.data.frame(fisher.alpha(asv_table, MARGIN = 1)), 
              as.data.frame(specnumber(asv_table, MARGIN = 1)),
              as.data.frame(reads))
colnames(meta_alpha) <- c("shannon", "simpson", "fisher a", "species", "reads")

#I want pielou's evenness number as well so I can just see evenness...
meta_alpha$pielouJ <- meta_alpha$shannon / log(meta_alpha$species)

#write.csv(meta_alpha, "meta_alpha.csv") #save a csv to look at later, optional
rm(reads)

#Join `metadata` dataframe at this step, based on **only which samples have been retained due to filtering** as represented in the `meta` dataframe, which has just been derived from the `asv_table`
metadata <- as.data.frame(metadata) #For some reason it isn't already a data table, and breaks the merge...
rownames(metadata) <- metadata$SampleID #Rename metadata rows
meta <- merge(meta_alpha, metadata, by=0, all.x=TRUE) #Add metadata to meta
rownames(meta) <- meta$NewName #Rename the rows with the new standard sample names

#rownames(meta) <- make.names(meta$NewName, unique = TRUE) #Do not try "makenames"
rownames(asv_table) <- meta$NewName #Now rename the asv_table too
#Everything should now be compatible.
rm(meta_alpha) #Don't need it anymore

#Clean up meta a little bit
meta$Row.names<- NULL
meta$Sample<- NULL
meta$SampleAmpliconTutorialFilter<-NULL

#Remove ECB / extraction control blanks
meta <- subset(meta, Type != "ECB") 
meta <- subset(meta, Construction != "ECB") 

```

```{r warning=FALSE}
## useful functions for generating PICRUSt2 input

#---- phyloseq_counts_to_df
# Converts phyloseq into a data frame which can be used to export the
# ASVs and samples with their counts to a file. This function also
# adds a new column with the ASV IDs to the front.
phyloseq_counts_to_df <- function(ps) {
  df <- as.data.frame(t(otu_table(ps)))
  df <- cbind("#OTU ID" = rownames(df), df)  # Cheeky way to add a comment to first line

  # Note: we use OTU ID above since at the moment this function is meanly used
  # to pipe files into picrust, which needs the 'OTU ID'.
  return(df)
}


#---- write_counts_to_file
# Write the (raw) counts from a phyloseq object as a data matrix to file.
#
# INPUT  ps           : phyloseq object
#        file_name    : full file name (incl. path if required when not writing
#                       to working directory)

write_counts_to_file <- function(ps, filename) {
  df <- phyloseq_counts_to_df(ps)

  write.table(df, file=filename,
sep = "\t",
              row.names = FALSE)
}

#---- write_seqs_to_file
# Write the sequences from a phyloseq object as a fasta file.
#
# INPUT  ps           : phyloseq object
#        filename    : full file name (incl. path if required when not writing
#                       to working directory)
write_seqs_to_file <- function(ps, filename) {
  df <- as.data.frame(refseq(ps))

  unlink(filename)  # make sure we delete before we concatenate below

  names <- rownames(df)
  for (i in 1:nrow(df)) {
    cat(paste0(">", names[i]), file=filename, sep="\n", append=TRUE)
    cat(df[i,1], file=filename, sep="\n", append=TRUE)
  }
  message(paste0("Wrote ", nrow(df), " ASV sequences to file ", filename))
}
```

I'm only interested in seeing which ASVs are assigned sulfate-reducing functions... begin manual searching for sulfite reductase, or dissimilatory sulfate reduction.

Sulfate reduction involves some of the following pathways.

GENE    KO        EC
  SO42- to SO32- =======================
    dissimilatory sulfite reductase
      dsrA    K11180    [EC:1.8.1.22]
      dsrB    K11181    [EC:1.8.1.22]

  SO32- to HS-   =======================
    sulfate adenylyltransferase
      Sat     K00958    [EC:2.7.7.4]
    adenylylsulfate reductase
      AprB    K00395    [EC:1.8.99.2]
      AprA    K00394    [EC:1.8.99.2]
    quinone-modifying oxidoreductase
      QmoA    K16885
      QmoB    K16886
      QmoC    K16887
     
We'll look for ASVs that have dsrAB (either), aprAB (both), and sat

I also want the KO information (KEGG ortholog) by ASV / sequence is in combined_KO_predicted.tsv

```{r}

ko_pred <- fread("C:/Users/runet/Documents/WORK/Labwork/2024 MGA/picrust2/results/combined_KO_predicted.tsv")

ko_pred <- as.data.frame(ko_pred)
p2KO <- as.data.frame(p2KO)

# Match KO IDs to descriptions
ko_descriptions <- p2KO$description
names(ko_descriptions) <- rownames(p2KO)

ko_annotation <- data.frame(func = colnames(ko_pred),description = ko_descriptions[colnames(ko_pred)])

# Manual list of KOs I'm interested in
my_KOs <- c(
    "ko:K11180", #dsrA
    "ko:K11181", #dsrB
    "ko:K00958", #Sat
    "ko:K00395", #AprB
    "ko:K00394") #AprA

# Find which KOs actually exist in ko_pred
KOs_found <- intersect(my_KOs, colnames(ko_pred))

# Select ASVs having >0 predicted copies for
# at least one of the KOs
asv_has_KO <- rowSums(ko_pred[, KOs_found, drop = FALSE] > 0,na.rm = TRUE) > 0

# Get ASV IDs
selected_asvs <- rownames(ko_pred)[asv_has_KO]

# Get taxonomy for selected ASVs
taxonomy_selected <- taxonomy[selected_asvs,,drop = FALSE]

# Add TRUE/FALSE columns for each KO
KO_matches <- ko_pred[selected_asvs,KOs_found,drop = FALSE] > 0
# Combine taxonomy + KO matches
taxonomy_selected <- cbind(taxonomy_selected,KO_matches)

#keep when *either* dsr A or dsr B are present, and aprA, aprB, and sat are all present. 
taxonomy_selected <- taxonomy_selected %>% filter((`ko:K11180` | `ko:K11181`) & `ko:K00395` & `ko:K00394` & `ko:K00958`)

#Export for manual checking
write.csv(taxonomy_selected, "taxonomy_selected.csv", row.names = TRUE)

#Import manually annotated xlsx file. Taxonomy selected for inclusion are designated "TRUE" in 
taxonomy_selected_filtered<-read_excel("taxonomy_selected_annotated.xlsx")  

#Filter only TRUE ASVs

#Optional, use filtered list to pick up ASVs that may have been lost in PICRUSt pipeline by taxonomic proximity -- match names and pull any ASVs with identical taxonomy to included taxa from PICRUSt output
taxonomy_selected_filtered_expanded <- semi_join(taxonomy, taxonomy_selected_filtered, by = "tax_label")

#Add this list of ASVS to the list of "desulfo" ASVs
putitativeSRB2 <- taxonomy_selected_filtered$ASV
putitativeSRB <- unique(c(putitativeSRB,putitativeSRB2))
```

# █ Ordination (Beta Diversity)

## PCAs 

Generate a PCA from a log-center transformed ASV table with Euclidean distance, where Mini Gradient Array data is grouped by construction, and MGA, iChip, and Filter (GL) points are all plotted.

Note that a log-center transformed (inherently Euclidean) PCA is mathematically identical to a PCoA with Euclidean distance.

PCA was chosen for analysis as recommended by Gloor et al 2017:

Gloor GB, Macklaim JM, Pawlowsky-Glahn V and Egozcue JJ (2017) Microbiome Datasets Are Compositional: And This Is Not Optional. Front. Microbiol. 8:2224. doi: 10.3389/fmicb.2017.02224

```{r, warning=FALSE}

metaSet <- meta
PCAset <- doPCA(asv_table, metaSet)

scores_df1 <- PCAset$scores %>%
  mutate(GroupVar = metaSet$AlphaType, Construction = metaSet$Construction, HoverText = paste("Sample:", rownames(PCAset$scores)))

p <- ggplot(scores_df1, aes(PC1, PC2)) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = GroupVar, fill = GroupVar, colour = GroupVar), geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.05, type = "norm", level = 0.90) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = GroupVar, colour = GroupVar), type = "norm", level = 0.90, linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_point(aes(colour = Construction, fill = Construction, shape = Construction), size = 2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = mgacolors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = mgacolors) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(MGA = 16, M = 16, TS = 17, F = 15, I = 18)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-0.05, 0.35)) +
  labs(title = "Green Lake and In-situ Device Community Composition", subtitle = "a)", x = paste0("PC1: ", PCAset$exp[1], "%"), y = paste0("PC2: ", PCAset$exp[2], "%")) +
  theme_q2r() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"), plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10))

p

# Save plot
# ggsave(file = "PCA_newskinny.svg", device=svg, plot = p,width=3,height=5)

# ggplotly(p, tooltip = c("text")) %>%
  #style(hoverinfo = "skip", traces = c(1,2)) 

```

## Betadisper

Calculate the beta dispersion of each MGA group (Group ID, individual array) and track it over time, faceting based on location and based on construction.

```{r, warning=FALSE}
  
# Subset data
metaSet <- subset(meta, !Construction %in% c("I", "F"))

# Calculate distance matrix + do betadisper
asvSet <- as.data.frame(asvSet %>% t() %>% make_clr() %>% t())
perm_dist <- getDist(asv_table, metaSet)

# Do betadisper
bd <- betadisper(perm_dist, metaSet$GroupID)
beta_disp <- data.frame(GroupID = names(bd$group.distances), BetaDispersion = bd$group.distances)

# Summarise metadata
meta_summary <- metaSet %>%
  group_by(GroupID) %>%
  summarise(DaysIncubated = unique(DaysIncubated)[1], Construction = unique(Construction)[1], .groups = "drop")

#Join metadata
beta_disp <- beta_disp %>%
  left_join(meta_summary, by = "GroupID") %>%
  mutate(Construction = dplyr::recode(Construction, M = "Middle", TS = "TopSeal"))

p3 <- ggplot(beta_disp, aes(DaysIncubated, BetaDispersion, colour = Construction, group = Construction)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_color_manual(values = mgacolors) +
  labs(subtitle = "c) MGA Beta Dispersion over Time", x = "Days Incubated", y = "Beta Dispersion") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.02, 0.98), legend.justification = c(0, 1), legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA), plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10))

p3
```

## Substrate RDA 

Substrate has a significant effect in the PERMANOVA, but the trend(s) can't be seen in the PCA as they are overwritten by the effects of days incubated and construction. An RDA isolates the dataset variability owed to substrate alone.

CCA (Canonical Correspondence Analysis) is not viable for this use case since substrate is a categorical variable and CCA does not accommodate categorical variables.

Before the RDA, let's look at pairwise comparisons of the substrates between (not among) each other. Colors by p value and percents are R\^2 values multiplied by 100.

```{r}

# Reset data filter
metaSet <- subset(meta, !Construction %in% c("I", "F"))
asvSet <- as.data.frame(subset(asv_table, row.names(asv_table) %in% row.names(metaSet)))

perm_dist <- getDist(asv_table, metaSet)
perma <- adonis2(perm_dist ~ Construction * DaysIncubated * OrgSub, data = metaSet, permutations = 9999, by = "margin")
perma

disp <- betadisper(perm_dist, metaSet$OrgSub)
beta_disp <- data.frame(GroupID = names(disp$group.distances), BetaDispersion = disp$group.distances)
anova(disp)
permutest(disp)

# Pairwise adonis to look at substrates pairwise
pairwise.adonis2 <- function(x, factors, perm = 99) {
  combs <- combn(unique(factors), 2, simplify = FALSE)
  out <- lapply(combs, function(i) {
    sel <- factors %in% i
    ad <- adonis2(x[sel, sel] ~ factors[sel], permutations = perm)
    data.frame(group1 = i[1], group2 = i[2], F = ad$F[1], R2 = ad$R2[1], p = ad$`Pr(>F)`[1])
  })
  do.call(rbind, out)
}

hi <- pairwise.adonis2(perm_dist, metaSet$OrgSub, perm = 99)

library(scales)
hi$R_percent <- percent(hi$R, accuracy = 1)
hi$p_cat <- cut(hi$p, breaks = c(-Inf, 0.01, 0.05, Inf), labels = c("≤0.01", "0.01–0.05", ">0.05"))

ggplot(hi, aes(group1, group2)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = p_cat), color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = R_percent), size = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("≤0.01" = "red", "0.01–0.05" = "mistyrose", ">0.05" = "white"), name = "p-value") +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = "Substrate Group 1", y = "Substrate Group 2") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

rm(perm_dist, perma, disp, beta_disp, pairwise.adonis2, hi)

```

Follow up with the actual redundancy analysis (RDA) to investigate of the effect of substrate on MGA community composition.

```{r}

# Data filter does not need to be reset at this stage.

# Run an RDA model that is only substrates so that axes are linear combinations of substrates
asvSetLater <- asvSet

# Reminder to log-center transform this again
# Since RDAs are euclidean, this will be equivalent/comparable to the PCAs we make later
asvSet <- asvSet %>% t() %>% make_clr() %>% t()

# Refactor
metaSet$OrgSub <- relevel(factor(metaSet$OrgSub), ref = "Blank")

# Do the RDA
rda_mod <- rda(asvSet ~ OrgSub + Condition(DaysIncubated + Construction), data = metaSet)

# Make scores dataframes
scores_df <- as.data.frame(scores(rda_mod, display = "sites"))
scores_df$Substrate <- metaSet$Substrate

site_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(rda_mod, display = "sites"))
species_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(rda_mod, display = "species"))
biplot_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(rda_mod, display = "bp"))

rownames(biplot_scores) <- gsub("OrgSub", "", rownames(biplot_scores))
biplot_scores$Substrate <- rownames(biplot_scores)

# Rename species scores with taxonomy
taxonomy <- as.data.frame(taxonomy)
species_scores <- merge(species_scores, taxonomy, by.x = "row.names", by.y = "ASV", all.x = TRUE)
rownames(species_scores) <- species_scores$Row.names
species_scores$Row.names <- NULL

# Add metadata to sites
site_scores$Substrate <- factor(as.character(metaSet$OrgSub))
site_scores$Construction <- metaSet$Construction
site_scores$DaysInc <- metaSet$DaysIncubated
site_scores$Groupy <- paste(site_scores$Substrate, site_scores$DaysInc)
site_scores$RDA1abs <- abs(site_scores$RDA1)
site_scores$RDA2abs <- abs(site_scores$RDA2)

# Split data by Substrate
split_data <- split(site_scores, site_scores$Substrate)

# Calculate centroids + SE for each group
centroids <- lapply(split_data, function(df) {
  data.frame(
    Substrate = unique(df$Substrate),
    RDA1 = mean(df$RDA1),
    RDA2 = mean(df$RDA2),
    se.RDA1 = sd(df$RDA1) / sqrt(nrow(df)),
    se.RDA2 = sd(df$RDA2) / sqrt(nrow(df))
  )
}) %>% do.call(rbind, .)

# Reset rownames
rownames(centroids) <- NULL
```

```{r}
## Strongest ASV-substrate correlations are assigned first

# Add species label
species_scores$label <- apply(species_scores[, c("Phylum","Order","Family","Genus","Species")], 1, function(x) {
  paste(tail(x[!is.na(x) & x != "NA" & x != ""], 2), collapse = " ")
})

# Make species and substrate vector matrices
species_mat <- as.matrix(species_scores[, c("RDA1","RDA2")])
vec_mat <- as.matrix(biplot_scores[, c("RDA1","RDA2")])

# Calculate dot product of EVERY ASV against EVERY substrate
score_matrix <- species_mat %*% t(vec_mat)
colnames(score_matrix) <- biplot_scores$Substrate
rownames(score_matrix) <- rownames(species_scores)

# Create every possible ASV-substrate combination
pairs <- expand.grid(
  ASV = rownames(score_matrix),
  Substrate = colnames(score_matrix),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Add correlation/dot-product score
pairs$score <- mapply(
  function(asv, substrate) score_matrix[asv, substrate],
  pairs$ASV,
  pairs$Substrate
)

# Sort strongest associations first
pairs <- pairs[order(pairs$score, decreasing = TRUE), ]

# Greedily assign unique ASVs to substrates
# Once an ASV is assigned, no other substrate can use it
# Once a substrate is assigned, it cannot receive another ASV
used_asvs <- character(0)
used_substrates <- character(0)
assignments <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(pairs))) {
  if (!(pairs$ASV[i] %in% used_asvs) &&
      !(pairs$Substrate[i] %in% used_substrates)) {
    
    assignments[[length(assignments) + 1]] <- pairs[i, ]
    used_asvs <- c(used_asvs, pairs$ASV[i])
    used_substrates <- c(used_substrates, pairs$Substrate[i])
  }
}

# Combine assignments
top_species <- do.call(rbind, assignments)

# Add species information
top_species <- merge(
  top_species,
  species_scores,
  by.x = "ASV",
  by.y = "row.names"
)

rownames(top_species) <- top_species$ASV

# Add font style
top_species$fontface <- "bold"

# Assign each selected ASV to its substrate
species_scores$best_substrate <- "nosub"
species_scores$shape_type <- "nosub"

for (i in seq_len(nrow(top_species))) {
  species_scores$best_substrate[
    rownames(species_scores) == top_species$ASV[i]
  ] <- top_species$Substrate[i]
  
  species_scores$shape_type[
    rownames(species_scores) == top_species$ASV[i]
  ] <- "assigned"
}

# Plot
p2 <- ggplot() +
  xlab(paste0("RDA1: ", round(rda_mod[["CCA"]][["eig"]][["RDA1"]], 3), "%")) +
  ylab(paste0("RDA2: ", round(rda_mod[["CCA"]][["eig"]][["RDA2"]], 2), "%")) +
  geom_point(
    data = species_scores,
    aes(RDA1, RDA2, color = best_substrate, shape = shape_type),
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(nosub = 4, assigned = 16)) +
  geom_segment(
    data = biplot_scores,
    aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = RDA1, yend = RDA2, color = Substrate),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")),
    type = "closed",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = biplot_scores,
    aes(RDA1, RDA2, label = Substrate, color = Substrate),
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = top_species,
    aes(RDA1, RDA2, label = label, color = Substrate),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(mgacolors, nosub = "grey70")) +
  theme_minimal()

p2

# Remove intermediate objects
rm(species_mat, vec_mat, score_matrix, pairs, top_species)
```

## Heatmap by substrate

Construct a substrate and taxa heatmap, collapsed by label, where only significant (p\<0.05) correlations are plotted. After collapsing by label, taxa are filtered for prevalence (at least 1% abundant in two samples / culture columns)

"Label" in this case collapses taxa by last two taxonomic designations in SILVA.

E.g. *Bacteria Proteobacteria Gammaproteobacteria Burkholderiales Burkholderiaceae Limnobacter thiooxidans* will have the label "*Limnobacter thiooxidans"*

Whereas *Bacteria Elusimicrobiota Elusimicrobia Lineage IV NA NA NA* will have the label "*Elusimicrobia Lineage IV"*

```{r}

library(Hmisc)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Reset data filter
metaSet <- subset(meta, !Construction %in% c("I", "F"))
asvSet <- as.data.frame(subset(asv_table, row.names(asv_table) %in% row.names(metaSet)))

asvSet <- asvSet[rownames(metaSet), ]
asv_rel <- asvSet / rowSums(asvSet)

#Iterate and add label, which is made up of the last two names before an NA shows up
species_scores$label <- apply(species_scores[, c("Phylum", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species")], 1, function(x) paste(tail(x[!is.na(x) & x != "NA" & x != ""], 2), collapse = " "))

# ASV -> taxon lookup
tax_lookup <- species_scores[, "label", drop = FALSE]
tax_lookup$ASV <- rownames(species_scores)

# Keep only ASVs present in abundance table
tax_lookup <- tax_lookup[tax_lookup$ASV %in% colnames(asv_rel), ]

# Match lookup to ASV order
tax_lookup <- tax_lookup[match(colnames(asv_rel), tax_lookup$ASV), ]

# Replace missing labels with ASV IDs (optional)
tax_lookup$label[is.na(tax_lookup$label)] <- tax_lookup$ASV[is.na(tax_lookup$label)]

# Transpose so ASVs become rows
tmp <- as.data.frame(t(asv_rel))
tmp$label <- tax_lookup$label

# Sum ASVs belonging to the same taxon
tmp_taxa <- aggregate(. ~ label, data = tmp, FUN = sum)

# Back to samples x taxa
rownames(tmp_taxa) <- tmp_taxa$label
tmp_taxa$label <- NULL
asv_rel_taxa <- t(as.matrix(tmp_taxa))

# Filter taxa by prevalence
asv_filtered <- asv_rel_taxa[, apply(asv_rel_taxa, 2, function(x) sum(x >= 0.01) >= 2)]

# Create substrate dummy variables
substrate_mat <- model.matrix(~ OrgSub - 1, data = metaSet)
colnames(substrate_mat) <- gsub("^OrgSub", "", colnames(substrate_mat))

# Correlations
cor_input <- cbind(substrate_mat, asv_filtered)
cor_test <- rcorr(as.matrix(cor_input), type = "spearman")

n_sub <- ncol(substrate_mat)
rho_mat <- cor_test$r[1:n_sub, (n_sub + 1):ncol(cor_input)]
p_mat <- cor_test$P[1:n_sub, (n_sub + 1):ncol(cor_input)]

# Convert to long format
cor_df <- expand.grid(Substrate = rownames(rho_mat), label = colnames(rho_mat))
cor_df$Correlation <- as.vector(rho_mat)
cor_df$p_value <- as.vector(p_mat)

# FDR correction
cor_df$FDR <- p.adjust(cor_df$p_value, method = "BH")

# Significant taxa
cor_sig <- cor_df %>% filter(p_value < 0.05)

# Distribution of correlations
hist(cor_df$Correlation, breaks = 50, main = "Taxon-substrate Spearman correlations", xlab = "Spearman rho")

# Heatmap
ggplot(cor_sig, aes(x = Substrate, y = label, fill = Correlation)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1), name = "Spearman\nrho") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10), panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  labs(x = "OrgSub", y = "Taxon")

```

## Heatmap putative SRB
Obviously, compare if sulfate reducers with enriched in substrates above blank and glucose...

```{r}

# Reset data filter
metaSet <- subset(meta, !Construction %in% c("I", "F"))
asvSRB_save<-asvSRB
asvSRB <- as.data.frame(subset(asvSRB, row.names(asvSRB) %in% row.names(metaSet)))

# Remove ASVs absent from all samples
asvSRB <- asvSRB[, colSums(asvSRB) > 0, drop = FALSE]
asvSRB <- asvSRB[rowSums(asvSRB) > 0, , drop = FALSE]

# Convert counts to relative abundance per sample
asv_rel <- asvSRB / rowSums(asvSRB)

# ASV -> taxon lookup
tax_lookup <- species_scores[, "label", drop = FALSE]
tax_lookup$ASV <- rownames(species_scores)

# Keep ASVs present in abundance table
tax_lookup <- tax_lookup[tax_lookup$ASV %in% colnames(asv_rel), ]

# Match ASV order to abundance table
tax_lookup <- tax_lookup[match(colnames(asv_rel), tax_lookup$ASV), ]

# Replace missing labels with ASV IDs
tax_lookup$label[is.na(tax_lookup$label)] <- tax_lookup$ASV[is.na(tax_lookup$label)]

# Collapse ASVs sharing the same taxon label
tmp <- as.data.frame(t(asv_rel))
tmp$label <- tax_lookup$label
tmp_taxa <- aggregate(. ~ label, data = tmp, FUN = sum)

# Return taxa as rows
rownames(tmp_taxa) <- tmp_taxa$label
tmp_taxa$label <- NULL

# Samples x taxa
asv_rel_taxa <- t(as.matrix(tmp_taxa))

# Filter taxa:
# keep taxa reaching >=1% relative abundance in at least 2 samples
asv_filtered <- asv_rel_taxa[, apply(asv_rel_taxa, 2, function(x) sum(x >= 0.01) >= 2), drop = FALSE]

# Match metadata to ASV table samples
metaSet_cor <- metaSet[rownames(asv_filtered), , drop = FALSE]

# Recreate substrate matrix with matching samples
substrate_mat <- model.matrix(~ OrgSub - 1, data = metaSet_cor)
colnames(substrate_mat) <- gsub("^OrgSub", "", colnames(substrate_mat))

# Correlation matrix input
cor_input <- cbind(substrate_mat, asv_filtered)

# Spearman correlations
cor_test <- rcorr(as.matrix(cor_input), type = "spearman")
n_sub <- ncol(substrate_mat)

rho_mat <- cor_test$r[1:n_sub, (n_sub + 1):ncol(cor_input), drop = FALSE]
p_mat <- cor_test$P[1:n_sub, (n_sub + 1):ncol(cor_input), drop = FALSE]

# Convert to long format
cor_df <- expand.grid(Substrate = rownames(rho_mat), label = colnames(rho_mat))
cor_df$Correlation <- as.vector(rho_mat)
cor_df$p_value <- as.vector(p_mat)

# FDR correction
cor_df$FDR <- p.adjust(cor_df$p_value, method = "BH")

# Significant correlations
cor_sig <- cor_df %>% filter(p_value < 0.05)

# Correlation distribution
hist(cor_df$Correlation, breaks = 50, main = "Taxon-substrate Spearman correlations", xlab = "Spearman rho")

# Heatmap
ggplot(cor_sig, aes(x = Substrate, y = label, fill = Correlation)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1), name = "Spearman\nrho") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10), panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  labs(x = "OrgSub", y = "Taxon")
```

## Tukey Test + Alpha Diversity

```{r}
library(ggpubr)

# Reset the metadata subset
metaSet <- meta
asvSet <- as.data.frame(subset(asv_table, row.names(asv_table) %in% row.names(metaSet)))

# Further Remove groups not used in plotting just in case they've slipped in
metaPlot <- metaSet %>% filter(!Construction %in% c("ECB", "BIO"))

# Define the specific despired pairwise comparisons
my_comparisons <- list(c("Filter", "MGA"), c("Filter", "iChip"), c("MGA", "iChip"))

# Summarize for plotting
dt <- metaPlot %>% group_by(AlphaType) %>% summarise(mean = mean(species, na.rm = TRUE), quant = quantile(species, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), quant100 = max(species, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# T-test
stat_test <- compare_means(species ~ AlphaType, data = metaPlot, comparisons = my_comparisons, method = "t.test")

# Apply significance stars to t-test for plotting
stat_test$label <- symnum(stat_test$p, corr = FALSE, cutpoints = c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 1), symbols = c("***", "**", "*", "ns"))
```

# █ Taxonomic Barplot

Original source code from the Bisanz Lab qiime2R package function taxa_barplot was used as a base for the following code, which generates a taxonomic barplot.

## Top 10 taxa by Class

```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=7,fig.height=4}


#Subset for plotting the bar plot
metaSet <- subset(meta, Construction != "TO")
metaSet <- subset(metaSet, Location != "BR")
asvSet <- subset(asv_table, row.names(asv_table) %in% row.names(metaSet))
asvSet <- as.data.frame(asvSet)
metaSet <- metaSet %>% mutate(OrgSub = if_else(OrgSub == "None", "Blank", OrgSub))

# Add GroupID to ASV table
asvSet$GroupID <- metaSet$GroupID

metaSet$AlphaFill[metaSet$AlphaFill == "TopSeal"] <- "TopSealed MGA"
metaSet$AlphaFill[metaSet$AlphaFill == "Middle"] <- "Middle MGA"

metaSet <- metaSet %>% mutate(
  Abbr = case_when(
    AlphaType == "Filter" & str_detect(NewName, "09") ~ "Sep",
    AlphaType == "Filter" & str_detect(NewName, "10") ~ "Oct",
    AlphaType == "Filter" & str_detect(NewName, "11") ~ "Nov",
    AlphaType == "iChip" ~ "Nov",
    TRUE ~ as.character(Abbr)
  )
)

# Create conditional grouping variable
metaSet <- metaSet %>% mutate(
  GroupVar = if_else(
    AlphaType == "Filter",
    as.character(Abbr),
    as.character(OrgSub)
  )
)

# Average each ASV across GroupID + conditional grouping variable
asvSet <- asvSet %>%
  mutate(GroupID = metaSet$GroupID, GroupVar = metaSet$GroupVar) %>%
  group_by(GroupID, GroupVar) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(across(where(is.numeric), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  unite("NewName", GroupID, GroupVar, remove = FALSE) %>%
  column_to_rownames("NewName")

#Create an "average" / mean row for all the same GroupIDs
# calculate group means
group_means <- asvSet %>%
  group_by(GroupID) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(across(where(is.numeric), mean, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(GroupID = paste0(GroupID, "_mean")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  unite("NewName", GroupID, remove = FALSE) %>%
  column_to_rownames("NewName")
group_means$GroupVar <- "NA"
# append them as new rows
df_new <- bind_rows(asvSet, group_means)
rm(group_means)

# Collapse metadata the same way
metaSet <- metaSet %>%
  group_by(GroupID, GroupVar) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    across(where(is.numeric), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    across(where(~ !is.numeric(.x)), ~ first(.x)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  unite("NewName", GroupID, GroupVar, remove = FALSE)

#Summarize the taxa in an asv table that's being subset by metaSet
asvSet[, c(1, 2)] <- list(NULL)
taxasum <- summarize_taxa(features = as.data.frame(t(asvSet)), taxonomy = taxonomy %>% column_to_rownames("ASV"))
features = taxasum$Class #Change this to Phylum, Order, etc... 
features <- as.data.frame(make_proportion(features))
plotfeats <- names(sort(rowMeans(features, na.rm = TRUE), decreasing = TRUE)[1:10]) # extract the top N most 

metaSet$Type[metaSet$Type == "Middle"] <- "Middle MGA"
metaSet$Type[metaSet$Type == "TopSeal"] <- "TopSeal MGA"

metaSet$GroupVar <- factor(
  metaSet$GroupVar,
  levels = c(
    "n/a",
    "none",
    "Sep",
    "Oct",
    "Nov",
    "Blank",
    "Acetate",
    "Formate",

    "Glycerol",
    "Propionate",
    "Pyruvate",
        "Glucose"
  )
)


fplot <- features %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Taxon") %>%
  gather(-Taxon, key = "NewName", value = "Abundance") %>%
  mutate(Taxon = if_else(Taxon %in% plotfeats, Taxon, "Remainder")) %>%
  group_by(Taxon, NewName) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(Abundance = sum(Abundance)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Taxon = factor(Taxon, levels = rev(c(plotfeats, "Remainder")))) %>%
  merge(metaSet, by = "NewName") %>%
  mutate(
    NewName = factor(
      NewName,
      levels = metaSet$NewName[order(metaSet$GroupVar)]
    )
  )

fplot <- fplot %>%
  mutate(
    GroupVar = factor(
      GroupVar,
      levels = c(
        "n/a",
        "none",
        "Sep",
        "Oct",
        "Nov",
        "Blank",
        "Acetate",
        "Formate",
        "Glycerol",
        "Propionate",
        "Pyruvate",
        "Glucose"
      )
    ),
    NewName = factor(
      NewName,
      levels = unique(NewName[order(GroupVar)])
    )
  )

#separate Taxon into columns based on the location of the ;
fplot <- fplot %>% tidyr::separate(Taxon, c('Kingdom', 'Phylum', 'Class', 'Order', 'Family', 'Genus', 'Species'), sep = '\\;', remove = FALSE, fill = "right")

bplot <- ggplot(fplot, aes(x = NewName, y = Abundance, fill = Taxon)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1.2) +
  theme_q2r() +
  theme(panel.border = element_blank()) +
  # theme(text = element_text(family = "mono"))+
  #theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90, hjust=1)) +
  coord_cartesian(expand = FALSE) +
  xlab("") +
  ylab("Abundance") +
  facet_nested(. ~ Type + DaysIncubated, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x", nest_line = element_line(linetype = 2))

bplot <- bplot +
  scale_fill_manual(values = rev(q2r_palette), name = "") +
  ggtitle("Green Lake and in-situ Device Community Composition") +
  theme(legend.position = 'right', plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")) +
  labs(y = "% Abundance", subtitle = "Taxonomic Class by Sample (Averaged by Replicate)") +
  theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10), legend.text = element_text(size = 7)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = setNames(
      ifelse(
        metaSet$Abbr == "Filter", "",
        ifelse(metaSet$Abbr == "Glu", "Gl", metaSet$Abbr)
      ),
      metaSet$NewName
    )
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = rev(q2r_palette),
    name = "",
    labels = function(x) sapply(strsplit(x, ";"), function(z) paste(z[2], z[3], sep = "; "))
  )

bplot


ggsave(file = "BarGraph2.svg", device=svg, plot = bplot,width=10,height=7)
```

```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
  theme(panel.border = element_blank()) +

  xlab("") +
  ylab("Abundance") +
  facet_nested(. ~ Type + DaysIncubated, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x", nest_line = element_line(linetype = 2))

bplot <- bplot +
  scale_fill_manual(values = rev(cyberskittles), name = "", labels = function(x) sapply(strsplit(x, ";"), function(z) {
    z <- trimws(z)
    fam <- if(length(z) >= 5) z[5] else ""
    gen <- if(length(z) >= 6) z[6] else ""
    sp <- if(length(z) >= 7) z[7] else ""
    parts <- c()
    if(!is.na(fam) && fam != "") parts <- c(parts, paste0("", fam))
    if(!is.na(gen) && gen != "") parts <- c(parts, paste0("", gen))
    if(!is.na(sp) && sp != "") parts <- c(parts, paste0("", sp))
    if(length(parts) == 0) return("Remainder")
    paste(parts, collapse = " ")
  })) +
  ggtitle("Green Lake and in-situ Device Community Composition") +
  theme(legend.position = "right", plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"), plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10), legend.text = element_text(size = 7)) +
  labs(y = "% Abundance", subtitle = "Mean Taxonomic Class by Group") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = scales::percent)
```

```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=7,fig.height=4}
#Pit stop: redefine summarize_taxa, because we need to use dplyr::summarize...

summarize_taxa <-function (features, taxonomy) 
{
    taxlevels <- c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", 
        "Genus", "Species")
    if (missing(features)) {
        stop("Feature table not provided")
    }
    if (missing(taxonomy)) {
        stop("taxonomy table not provided")
    }
    if (sum(colnames(taxonomy) %in% taxlevels) != 7) {
        stop("Taxonomy does not contain expected columns containing Kingdom,Phylum,Class,Order,Family,Genus,Species.")
    }
    output <- list()
    for (lvl in taxlevels) {
        suppressMessages(output[[lvl]] <- features %>% as.data.frame() %>% 
            rownames_to_column("FeatureID") %>% gather(-FeatureID, 
            key = "SampleID", value = "Counts") %>% left_join(taxonomy %>% 
            rownames_to_column("FeatureID") %>% unite("Taxon", 
            taxlevels[1:grep(lvl, taxlevels)], sep = "; ") %>% 
            select(FeatureID, Taxon)) %>% group_by(SampleID, 
            Taxon) %>% dplyr::summarize(Counts = sum(Counts)) %>% ungroup() %>% 
            spread(key = SampleID, value = Counts) %>% as.data.frame() %>% 
            column_to_rownames("Taxon"))
    }
    return(output)
}
```

```{r}
# Redefine summarize_taxa
summarize_taxa <- function(features, taxonomy) {
  taxlevels <- c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species")
  if (missing(features)) stop("Feature table not provided")
  if (missing(taxonomy)) stop("taxonomy table not provided")
  if (sum(colnames(taxonomy) %in% taxlevels) != 7) stop("Taxonomy does not contain expected columns containing Kingdom,Phylum,Class,Order,Family,Genus,Species.")
  output <- list()
  for (lvl in taxlevels) {
    suppressMessages(output[[lvl]] <- features %>% as.data.frame() %>%
      rownames_to_column("FeatureID") %>%
      gather(-FeatureID, key = "SampleID", value = "Counts") %>%
      left_join(taxonomy %>% rownames_to_column("FeatureID") %>%
        unite("Taxon", taxlevels[1:grep(lvl, taxlevels)], sep = "; ") %>%
        select(FeatureID, Taxon)) %>%
      group_by(SampleID, Taxon) %>%
      dplyr::summarize(Counts = sum(Counts)) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      spread(key = SampleID, value = Counts) %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      column_to_rownames("Taxon"))
  }
  return(output)
}

# Summarize taxa
taxasum <- summarize_taxa(features = as.data.frame(t(asvSet)), taxonomy = taxonomy %>% column_to_rownames("ASV"))

features <- taxasum$Class

# Convert to proportions
features <- as.data.frame(make_proportion(features))

# Get top 10 taxa
plotfeats <- names(sort(rowMeans(features, na.rm = TRUE), decreasing = TRUE)[1:10])

metaSet$Type[metaSet$Type == "Middle"] <- "Middle MGA"
metaSet$Type[metaSet$Type == "TopSeal"] <- "TopSeal MGA"

# Convert sample-level data to long format and attach GroupID
fplot <- features %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Taxon") %>%
  gather(-Taxon, key = "NewName", value = "Abundance") %>%
  mutate(Taxon = if_else(Taxon %in% plotfeats, Taxon, "Remainder")) %>%
  merge(metaSet[, c("NewName", "GroupID", "Type", "DaysIncubated")], by = "NewName") %>%
  group_by(Taxon, GroupID, Type, DaysIncubated) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(Abundance = mean(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Taxon = factor(Taxon, levels = rev(c(plotfeats, "Remainder"))))

# Separate Taxon into columns
fplot <- fplot %>%
  tidyr::separate(Taxon, c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species"), sep = "\\;", remove = FALSE, fill = "right")

# Plot
biplot <- ggplot(fplot, aes(x = GroupID, y = Abundance, fill = Taxon)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.8) +
  theme_q2r() +
  theme(panel.border = element_blank()) +
  coord_cartesian(expand = FALSE) +
  xlab("") +
  ylab("% Abundance") +
  facet_nested(. ~ Type + DaysIncubated, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x", nest_line = element_line(linetype = 2)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = rev(q2r_palette), name = "", labels = function(x) sapply(strsplit(x, ";"), function(z) paste(z[2], z[3], sep = "; "))) +
  ggtitle("Green Lake and in-situ Device Community Composition") +
  theme(legend.position = "right", plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"), plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10), legend.text = element_text(size = 7)) +
  labs(subtitle = "Taxonomic Class by GroupID (Averaged by Replicate)") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = scales::percent)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# PICRUSt2 sulfate reducers
# ============================================================

# Keep only ASVs that are both:
#   1. in the Putitative SRB list
#   2. present in the current asvSet

asvSRB <- asvSet[, intersect(unlist(putitativeSRB), colnames(asvSet)), drop = FALSE]

# Extract those ASVs from the ASV abundance table
#asvSRB <- asvSet[, asvSRB, drop = FALSE]

# Make sure samples are in the same order as metaSet
asvSRB <- asvSRB[rownames(metaSet), ,drop = FALSE]

# Total PICRUSt2-defined sulfate-reducer abundance
metaSet$SRB_abundance <- rowSums(asvSRB,na.rm = TRUE)

# Relative abundance
metaSet$SRB_relative <- metaSet$SRB_abundance / rowSums(asvSet, na.rm = TRUE)

# Factorize 
metaSet$AlphaType <- factor(metaSet$GroupID)

#Doing stats
anova <- aov(SRB_relative ~ GroupID, data = metaSet)
anova

cld <- multcompLetters4(anova, tukey)

levels(metaSet$GroupID)

    ifelse(x <= 0.20,
           x / 0.20 * 0.80,

  },
  inverse = function(x) {
    ifelse(x <= 0.80,
           x / 0.80 * 0.20,
           0.20 + (x - 0.80) / 0.20 * 0.80)
  }
)
```

## Percent putative 'uncultivated'
Taxonomic lookup -- quick data table generation to compare percent uncultivated vs percent cultivated OF PUTITATIVE SRB -- NOT OVERALL -- in an overall iChip Filter and MGA

```{r}

asv_summary <- lapply(unique(metaSet$AlphaType), function(group) {
  samples <- rownames(metaSet[metaSet$AlphaType == group, ])
  x <- asvDesulfo[, samples, drop = FALSE]
  data.frame(Feature.ID = rownames(x), total = rowSums(x), AlphaType = group) %>%
    mutate(relative = total / sum(total))
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  left_join(taxa, by = "Feature.ID") %>%
  mutate(cultivation_status = ifelse(grepl("s__[^;]+", Taxon), "Cultivated", "Uncultivated"))

cultivation_summary <- asv_summary %>%
  group_by(AlphaType, cultivation_status) %>%
  summarise(relative = sum(relative), percent = relative * 100, .groups = "drop")

cultivation_summary
```

# █ Deviation-from Linear Ratio Plot for Filter vs MGA

Compare MGA and Filter 

```{r}

metaSet <- subset(metaSet, AlphaType != "iChip")

asvSet <- as.data.frame(subset(asv_table, row.names(asv_table) %in% metaSet$NewName))
metaSet <- as.data.frame(subset(metaSet, metaSet$NewName %in% row.names(asvSet)))

Total <- as.data.frame(prop.table(as.matrix(asvSet), margin = 1))
Total$RepName <- metaSet$NewNameNoRep[match(rownames(Total), metaSet$NewName)]
Total$Group <- metaSet$AlphaType[match(rownames(Total), metaSet$NewName)]

# replicate name, group, ASV, and "value" which is proportion of each ASV
Total_long <- Total %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = where(is.numeric), names_to = "ASV", values_to = "value")

# Now, get a mean and sd value for each ASV by filter and MGA
Alpha_summary <- Total_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Group, ASV) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), sd = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

pvals <- Total_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(ASV) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(p_value = wilcox.test(value ~ Group)$p.value, .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"))

Compare <- Alpha_summary %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Group, values_from = c(mean, sd)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(mean_Filter > 0, mean_MGA > 0)

taxonomy$tax_label <- apply(
  taxonomy[, c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species")],
  1,
  function(x) paste(tail(x[!is.na(x) & x != ""], 2), collapse = " ")
)

Compare <- Compare %>%
  dplyr::left_join(pvals, by = "ASV") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(taxonomy[, c("ASV", "tax_label")], by = "ASV") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(sig = !is.na(p_adj) & p_adj < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(
    direction = case_when(
      sig == FALSE ~ "Insig.",
      mean_MGA > mean_Filter ~ "MGA",
      TRUE ~ "Filter"
    )
  )

ven1 <- ggplot(Compare, aes(x = mean_Filter, y = mean_MGA, text = tax_label)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_point(aes(color = direction), size = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(Insig. = "grey80", MGA = "#ad4b9c", Filter = "#89d814")) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_x_log10() +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Filter mean relative abundance",
    y = "Other mean relative abundance",
    title = "Significant ASVs"
  )
```

```{r}
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Group, values_from = c(mean, sd))

Compare <- Compare %>%
  dplyr::filter(mean_MGA > 0, mean_iChip > 0)

taxonomy$tax_label <- apply(taxonomy[, c("Kingdom","Phylum","Class","Order","Family","Genus","Species")], 1, function(x) paste(tail(x[!is.na(x) & x != ""], 2), collapse = " "))

Compare <- Compare %>%
  dplyr::left_join(pvals, by = "ASV") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(taxonomy[, c("ASV","tax_label")], by = "ASV") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(sig = !is.na(p_adj) & p_adj < 0.05)


Compare <- Compare %>%
  mutate(
    direction = case_when(
      sig == FALSE ~ "ns",
      mean_iChip > mean_MGA ~ "iChip",
      TRUE ~ "MGA"
    )
  )

ven3<-ggplot(Compare, aes(x = mean_iChip, y = mean_MGA, text = tax_label)) +
  
  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey40"
  ) +

  geom_point(aes(color = direction), size = 1) +

  scale_color_manual(values = c(

  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_x_log10() +
  coord_equal() +

  theme_classic() +

  labs(
    x = "Filter mean relative abundance",
    y = "Other mean relative abundance",
    title = "Significant ASVs"
  )
```

kruskal wallace

```{r}

metaSet <- subset(meta, Location == "GL")
asvSet <- as.data.frame(subset(asv_table, row.names(asv_table) %in% metaSet$NewName))
metaSet <- as.data.frame(subset(metaSet, metaSet$NewName %in% row.names(asvSet)))


Total <- as.data.frame(prop.table(as.matrix(asvSet), margin = 1))

Total$RepName <- metaSet$NewNameNoRep[match(rownames(Total), metaSet$NewName)]
Total$Group <- metaSet$AlphaType[match(rownames(Total), metaSet$NewName)]

# replicate name, group, ASV, and "value" which is proportion of each ASV
Total_long <- Total %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = where(is.numeric), names_to = "ASV", values_to = "value")

library(FSA)

kw_results <- Total_long %>%
  group_by(ASV) %>%
  summarise(
    p_kw = kruskal.test(value ~ Group)$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(p_kw_adj = p.adjust(p_kw, method = "BH"))

sig_asvs <- kw_results %>%
  filter(p_kw_adj < 0.05)

means <- Total_long %>%
  group_by(ASV, Group) %>%
  summarise(mean_abund = mean(value), .groups = "drop")

winner <- means %>%
  group_by(ASV) %>%
  slice_max(mean_abund, n = 1) %>%
  ungroup()

sig_taxa <- sig_asvs %>%
  inner_join(winner, by = "ASV")

Filter_set <- sig_taxa %>%
  filter(Group == "Filter") %>%
  pull(ASV)

MGA_set <- sig_taxa %>%
  filter(Group == "MGA") %>%
  pull(ASV)

iChip_set <- sig_taxa %>%
  filter(Group == "iChip") %>%
  pull(ASV)

library(eulerr)

fit2 <- euler(list(
  Filter = Filter_set,
  MGA = MGA_set,
  iChip = iChip_set
))

plot(fit2,
  quantities = TRUE,
  fills = c("#1b9e77", "#d95f02", "#7570b3"),
  alpha = 0.5,
  labels = TRUE,
  edges = TRUE)
```

## Acetate Colorimetric Assay 


### Standard Curve Construction

Known concentrations of Sodium Acetate in DI water were measured on a spectrophotometer at 460 nm.

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(broom)

standard_curve <- tibble(
  Acetate_M = c(
    0.5,
    0.25,
    0.125,
    0.0625,
    0.03125,
    0.015625,
    0.0078125,
    0.00390625,
    0.001953125
  ),
  Abs460 = c(
    2.023,
    1.118,
    0.443,
    0.219,
    0.115,
    0.064,
    0.036,
    0.018,
    0.011
  )
)

# Linear regression
standard_model <- lm(
  Abs460 ~ Acetate_M,
  data = standard_curve
)

# Model summary
summary(standard_model)

# Extract standard curve intercept and slope
standard_intercept <- coef(standard_model)[["(Intercept)"]]
standard_slope <- coef(standard_model)[["Acetate_M"]]

# Linear view
ggplot(
  standard_curve,
  aes(x = Acetate_M, y = Abs460)
) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    formula = y ~ x,
    se = TRUE
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Acetate concentration (M)",
    y = "Absorbance at 460 nm"
  ) +
  theme_classic()

# Log view
ggplot(
  standard_curve,
  aes(x = Acetate_M, y = Abs460)
) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(
    x = "Acetate concentration (M, log scale)",
    y = "Absorbance at 460 nm"
  ) +
  theme_classic()
```

### Diffusion Test

OD460 was recorded over 200+ days of diffusion of acetate-plug gradient cultures in microcosms.

```{r}

OD460 <- read_csv("C:/Users/runet/Documents/WORK/Labwork/2024 MGA/OD460 Acetate Colorimetric Assay.csv")

initial_plug_concentration <- 1  # M
plug_volume <- 1                 # mL
chamber_volume <- 45             # mL

acetate_data <- OD460 %>%
  mutate(
    Silica = recode(Silica, "None" = "No silica", "60A" = "Silica gel"),
    Construction = recode(Construction, "TopSealed" = "Top sealed", "TopOutOfWater" = "Out of water")
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("0", "1", "2", "5", "12", "42", "237"), names_to = "Time", values_to = "OD460") %>%
  mutate(
    Time = as.numeric(Time),
    chamber_Acetate = pmax((OD460 - standard_intercept) / standard_slope, 0),
    chamber_Acetate_mmol = chamber_Acetate * chamber_volume,
    initial_Acetate_mmol = initial_plug_concentration * plug_volume,
    plug_Acetate_mmol = initial_Acetate_mmol - chamber_Acetate_mmol,
    plug_Acetate = if_else(Time == 0, initial_plug_concentration, plug_Acetate_mmol / plug_volume)
  )

acetate_summary <- acetate_data %>%
  group_by(Construction, Time) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_chamber_Acetate = mean(chamber_Acetate, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_chamber_Acetate = sd(chamber_Acetate, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_plug_Acetate = mean(plug_Acetate, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_plug_Acetate = sd(plug_Acetate, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

### Calculate Acetate Depletion Rate

acetate_fit <- acetate_data %>%
  filter(Construction == "Top sealed", Time >= 0, Time <= 42) %>%
  lm(plug_Acetate ~ Time, data = .)

fit_summary <- broom::tidy(acetate_fit)

depletion_slope <- coef(acetate_fit)[["Time"]]
depletion_intercept <- coef(acetate_fit)[["(Intercept)"]]
depletion_xint <- -depletion_intercept / depletion_slope

### Project Early Depletion Rate to 237 Days

projection_data <- data.frame(Time = seq(0, 237, length.out = 200))

fit_pred <- predict(acetate_fit, newdata = projection_data, interval = "confidence", level = 0.95)

projection_data <- cbind(
  projection_data,
  fit = fit_pred[, "fit"],
  ymin = fit_pred[, "lwr"],
  ymax = fit_pred[, "upr"]
)

### Calculate Actual 42-to-237 Day Depletion Rate

blue_42_237 <- acetate_summary %>%
  filter(Construction == "Top sealed", Time %in% c(42, 237)) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    slope = (mean_plug_Acetate[Time == 237] - mean_plug_Acetate[Time == 42]) / (237 - 42),
    xint = 42 - mean_plug_Acetate[Time == 42] / slope
  )

### Plot

hi <- ggplot(acetate_summary %>% filter(Construction == "Top sealed"), aes(x = Time)) +
  geom_ribbon(
    data = projection_data,
    aes(x = Time, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = "95% confidence interval"),
    alpha = 0.15,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_line(
    aes(y = mean_plug_Acetate, color = "Concentration (Plug)"),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(y = mean_plug_Acetate),
    color = "blue",
    shape = 17,
    size = 2
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_plug_Acetate - sd_plug_Acetate, ymax = mean_plug_Acetate + sd_plug_Acetate),
    color = "blue",
    width = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = blue_42_237,
    aes(x = xint, y = -0.015, label = paste0(sprintf("%.0f", xint), " Days")),
    color = "blue",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.01, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line(
    data = projection_data,
    aes(x = Time, y = fit, color = "Calculated depletion rate projected from early time points"),
    linewidth = 0.7,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = depletion_xint, color = "red", linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_text(
    data = data.frame(
      x = depletion_xint,
      y = -0.015,
      label = paste0(sprintf("%.0f", depletion_xint), " Days")
    ),
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
    color = "red",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Concentration (Plug)" = "blue",
    "Calculated depletion rate projected from early time points" = "red"
  )) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("95% confidence interval" = "red")) +
  labs(
    title = "Acetate Depletion Over Time",
    x = "Time (days)",
    y = "Acetate concentration (M)",
    color = NULL,
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 200), ylim = c(-0.1, NA)) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave(file = "acetate.svg", device=svg, plot = hi,width=9,height=7)

```
